title: Diagnose commercial metric movement
task: Reconcile revenue or customer-metric movement before choosing an intervention
exclusion: Not settled arithmetic, causal-effect certification or permission to spend

title: Turn positioning into useful copy
task: Write a supportable promise and actual copy against the buyer's real alternative
exclusion: Not a routine factual copy edit or proof of demand or conversion lift

title: Turn art direction into a working layout
task: Translate visual references into a coherent responsive composition with real content
exclusion: Not a token list alone or evidence of human aesthetic acceptance

title: Build and examine a repeatable core loop
task: Separate legibility, agency and development problems in a playable loop
exclusion: Not isolated runtime repair with settled design; designer walkthrough is not player observation

title: Edit and mix supplied audio
task: Improve a supplied narration or podcast through meaning-preserving edits and actual listening checks
exclusion: Not voice cloning, music generation, restoration certification or realtime DSP-code review

title: Design contrastive practice and transfer
task: Create worked reasoning, diagnostic feedback and fresh practice that tests the intended distinction
exclusion: A repeated revealed answer is not transfer; same-session success is not durable mastery

title: Calibrate voice without changing meaning
task: Translate authorized voice evidence into editing operations and compare controlled adaptations
exclusion: Not deceptive impersonation, universal voice rules or a mandatory process for one-line rewrites

title: Choose discriminating diagnostic experiments
task: Separate competing fault explanations and challenge intermittent or overfit repairs
exclusion: A successful rerun is not causal proof; diagnosis alone does not authorize implementation

title: Assemble a feasible creator campaign slate
task: Combine supplied creators, deliverable roles, quotes and usage rights within an aggregate campaign budget
exclusion: Not hiring, automatic bookings, granted rights or invented unique audience reach

title: Refine assets at their actual gameplay camera
task: Diagnose silhouette, material, motion and revision problems from the view where an asset is used
exclusion: Not mandatory realism, a new art style, or routine loading of an already approved asset

title: Choose causal design before estimation
task: Bind the estimand and available comparison to the assignment process before fitting a causal model
exclusion: Prediction alone is not this job; diagnostics cannot prove identifying assumptions

title: Budget telemetry cardinality without losing the question
task: Distinguish observed series, possible combinations and churn while retaining required diagnostic queries
exclusion: Theoretical series counts are not measured resource costs; hashing unique IDs does not reduce cardinality

title: Revise reader knowledge and reveals
task: Revise actual passages by separating world facts, viewpoint beliefs and information available to the reader
exclusion: Not compulsory mystery structure or a claim of blind human response from an informed editor
